name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST Twice, StartDate Updated Across AY Boundary
description: Variant of apprenticeship-draft-post-twice-startdate-updated: POSTs the same apprenticeship learner (ULN 44444447, standard 21) twice with no ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent in between, but this time the first POST's StartDate (2026-07-01) falls in the 2526 AY while the second POST's StartDate (2026-09-01) falls in the 2627 AY — the resubmission moves the draft's AY, not just its date within the same AY. CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle finds the draft learning already exists via GetByLearnerKey and merges the resubmission's changed fields via learning.Update(updateModel) — the second POST's StartDate change is applied, still on the same episode (no second episode is created). No approval step — the draft is left unapproved. Exploratory — no assertions on AY-specific behaviour yet.

steps.name: SLD Creates the Draft Apprenticeship (StartDate 2026-07-01, 2526 AY)
SLD Re-POSTs the Same Apprenticeship With a Changed StartDate (2026-09-01, 2627 AY)

assertions.name: Still only one episode for the learner
Episode StartDate matches the POSTed value
